title: Bag of bricks- Stone blue 18
descriptionHtml:
Stone Blue — colour 18

A soft grey-blue that reads as distance. Use it for overcast skies, far-off hills and hazy backgrounds — anywhere you want blue present but not assertive.

Works well with: Stone Grey 36, Aqua Blue 07, Cream 20

  • Precision-moulded, compatible with all Memobrick kits and standard building bricks
  • Ideal for replacing missing pieces or extending an existing design
  • Supplied in a resealable bag for easy sorting and storage

seo.description: Stone Blue bricks (colour 18) for Memobrick mosaics. A soft grey-blue for overcast skies, distant hills and calm, subtle backgrounds.
